gloss: reliable; dependable; someone you can count on

definitions.gloss: reliable; dependable; someone or something you can count on
definitions.explanation: Describes a person, thing, or quality that can be trusted and relied upon. Functions as an adjectival expression modifying nouns or as a predicate.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はいつも{頼|たよ}りになる。
{困|こま}ったときに{頼|たよ}りになるのは、やっぱり{家族|かぞく}だ。
examples.english: When you're in trouble, family is what you can really count on.

notes:
Composed of {頼|たよ}り (reliance, dependence — the noun form of {頼|たよ}る) + になる (to become/serve as). Literally "serves as something to rely on." One of the most common ways to express reliability in everyday Japanese.

USAGE:
Used both as a predicate ({頼|たよ}りになる) and as a noun modifier ({頼|たよ}りになる{人|ひと}). The negative form {頼|たよ}りにならない means "unreliable" and is equally common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頼|たよ}りになる{人|ひと} — reliable person
- {頼|たよ}りになる{存在|そんざい} — dependable presence
- {頼|たよ}りになる{味方|みかた} — reliable ally
- {頼|たよ}りにならない — unreliable, undependable

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {信頼|しんらい}できる — trustworthy (more formal; emphasizes trust)
- {当|あ}てになる — can be counted on (often used in the negative: {当|あ}てにならない)
- {心強|こころづよ}い — reassuring, encouraging (emotional sense of feeling supported)
